(339)༄༅/ /gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa rin 'byung las khol du phyungs pa bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (339)༄༅// gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu'i sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa rin 'byung las khol du phyungs pa bzhugs so//

(340)༄༅// oṃ swa sti// gang gi mtshan tsam thos pas kyang*// dus min 'chi ba nyer zhi zhing*// sdig sgrib mtha' dag sbyong mdzad pa'i// gtsug tor rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ spro na tshogs zhing spyan 'dren dang*/ yan lag bdun pa rgyas par bya/ mdor bsdu na tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 ho// stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i mchod rten du gyur pa ni/ rin po che'i rang bzhin seng khri'i steng du pad+ma/ de'i steng du khri zlum po bang rim sum brtsegs/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i bum pa zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba sgo dang bcas pa/ steng du rin po che'i bre/ gdugs bcu gsum/ char khebs tog dang bcas pa/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ dar gyi lda ldi sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o// de'i bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bh+rūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ser ba/ g.yon sngo zhing yid tsam khro ba/ zhal re re zhing zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gnyis pas pad+ma'i steng du 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa bsnams pa/ gsum pas mda' bzhi pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa (341)g.yon dang pos zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas gzhu/ gsum pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ bzhi pa ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang bcas pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o// de'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dkar po/

g.yas rnga yab dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du phyag na rdo rje sngon po/ g.yas rnga yab dang g.yon rdo rje sngon po 'dzin pa/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi phyogs bzhir khro bo bzhi gnas pa ni/ shar du mi g.yo ba g.yas ral gri phyar ba/ lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po g.yas lcags kyu phyar ba/ nub tu dbyug sngon g.yas dbyug pa phyar ba/ byang du stobs po che g.yas rdo rje rtse gsum phyar ba/ thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing kha rab tu khros pa/ phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod cing spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra nag po thor tshugs su byas pa/ stag lpags dang*/ sbrul gyi rgyan can/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o// gtso mo'i steng gi nam mkha' la gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ gtso mo la sku khrus gsol ba/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ dpral bar trāṃ ser po/ lte bar hrīḥdamar po/ brla gnyis la aṃ a ljang khu/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang (342)bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ /de bzhin du sbyar te/ ār+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag /chu lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las/ gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med/

phyag na rdo rje dang*/ khro bo bzhi la mi bskyod pa/ lha'i bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas/ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ /dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku// ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma// rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod// snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bh+rūm̐ yig bsrung bya sngags phreng dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.aṃ aḥ bdag dang bsrung bya la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ /zhes cung zad bzlas nas/ gtso bor gzungs ring nyid bzla'o// bzlas pa tshar nas/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar (343)bzhugs pa la mchod bstod/ yig brgya/ 'dod gsol/ bshags gsol rnams byas nas/ dge ba bsngos la/ thun mtshams la 'jug /gtor ma dkar gtor zhig /oṃ badz+ra yak+sha hūm̐ gis bsang*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la hā na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis sbyang*/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twata kyis byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam rgyal lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ gzungs ring tshar gcig gi mthar/ uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan bdun gyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol smon lam/ bkra shis rnams bya'o// 'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ stegs bu gru bzhi pa ras bzang pos g.yogs pa'i dbus su maṇ+ḍal gur gum gyis byugs par me tog gi tshom bu dbus su che ba gcig /g.yas g.yon du de las chung ba re/ de rgyab phyogs bzhir bzhi bkod/

byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog /shar du mchod yon/ shar lhor zhabs bsil/ lhor me tog /lho nub tu bdug spos/ nub tu mar me/ nub byang du dri chab// byang du lha bshos kyi bar du gtor 'bul dkar zlum bsham/ skyabs sems nas bdag bskyed bzlas pa gshegs gsol bar tshang bar btang*/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs ni/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ (344)rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu dpag tu med par gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ/ de nas mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las dri'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang sogs bdag bskyed ltar la/ rang nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ /'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ ces kha bsgyur/ mchod bstod dang bzlas pa bdun tsam gyis mnyes par bya/ gtor 'bul 'dod gsol bar bya ba la gtor mgron spyan 'dren mi dgos/ de nas slob ma rnams la khrus kyi phyir chab btang*/ me tog bkram bsdu dang*/ sems bskyed gsal btab la/ de'ang rgyud sde bzhi las sgrub thabs du ma gsungs pa rnams la/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon so sos sgrub thabs mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhugs pa yin la/ bsdus pa ba ri lo tsās bsgyur ba'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsar grags pa'i nang tshan rnam rgyal lha dgu'i rjes gnang sgrub pa ste/ spyir gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma 'di nyid ngo bo mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa yin kyang*/

sgrub na 'grub sla ba'i khyad par gyis gsang sngags su mi ston par gzungs sngags su mdzad cing lha mo'i rnam par bstan pas byin rlabs shin tu myur ba yin la/ 'di la bde ba can gyi gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang*/ ngan 'gro yongs sbyong gi gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang*/ 'chi bdag dbyug 'dzin gyi gtsug tor rnam rgyal te gzungs mdo gsum du bzhugs pa las/ da lta'i rnam rgyal lha dgu (345)'di nyid gzungs mdo dang po la brten par bzhed cing bya rgyud gshegs rigs kyi gtsug tor te/ 'di nyid kyi mtshan bzung ba dang gzungs sngags bzlas pa tsam gyis 'di phyi'i 'jigs pa kun las skyobs/ tshe ring du spel/ phyi ma bde ba can du skye nges pa sogs phan yon ngo mtshar mtha' yas pa dang ldan par gsungs pa'i rjes gnang gi cho ga la bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi bgyi bar 'os pa rnams sngon du grub zin pa lags pas/ da slob ma rnams kyi bya ba rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul mdzod/ slob mas 'dir maṇ+ḍal phul/ yang bla mas maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos gsungs shig /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ /lan gsum/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir/ mdun bskyed kyi lha dang sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi drung du rgyun bshags dang skyabs gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems bzung ba la sogs pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs gsum dang*/ khyad par du gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i rjes gnang stsal du gsol snyam pa'i 'dun pas 'di'i rjes zlos kyang gsungs shig /slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag la bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i rjes gnang ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyi gsol ba btab nas/

da sbyor ba rjes gnang gi gzhi (346)dgod cing sku'i rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzad par zhu/ oṃ shūn+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ phyi nang gi dngos po thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma sogs mngon rtogs ltar la/ rang nyid ces pa'i mal du/ khyed rang rnams bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma sogs nas/ gtso mo la sku khrus gsol ba'o bar brjod/ de nas slob dpon yang rang gis bsgom pa dang 'dra ba'i gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul// de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi lha dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku che chung ma nges pa dpag tu med pa byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi gtsug la sogs pa dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas char babs pa bzhin du sib sib thim par mos mdzod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ des sku'i rjes gnang thob/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag /lus lha bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no// gnyis pa gsung gi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon gyi snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bh+rūm̐ dkar po de las gzungs sngags kyi phreng ba byung slob dpon gyi kha nas thon/(347)khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du bh+rūm̐ dkar po gnas pa la thim/ de'i dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi mkhyen brtse nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par sngags phreng dang lhan cig zhal du zhugs/

snying ga'i bh+rūm̐ la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod la/ sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gsungs shig /gzungs ring lan gsum/ dang pos byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du 'dres/ gsum pas brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /ces lan gsum/ de ltar phul ba'i me tog de nyid slar yang byin gyis brlabs te/ khyed rang gi spyi bor phul ba'i mos pa mdzod cig /slob dpon gyis me tog gtor zhing*/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// rig pa 'dzin pa 'di rnams la bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma 'di nyid ji srid byang chub ma thob bar gyi yi dam du bzung ngo*/ bdag thugs kyis ma btang zhig snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos gsungs shig /slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa (348)'dzin pa ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma 'khor dang bcas pa yi dam gyi lhar bzung nas 'di'i gzungs sngags nyi ma re re bzhin 'don par dam bca' lags so/ /zhes lan gsum brjod/ des gsung gi rjes gnang thob/ ngag gi sgrib pa sbyangs/ ngag sngags bzla ba la dbang bar byas pa yin no// gsum pa thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun bskyed kyi lha la mos gus dung dung pa dang bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol snyam pa mdzad pas/ mdun bskyed kyi lha'i thugs ka nas gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sku sor tshad tsam cig rgyangs se byon/

khyed rang rnams kyi snying ga'i sa bon dang dbyer med du 'dres/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ des thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob/ yid kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ sems ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la dbang bar byas pa yin no/ de dag gis gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma lha dgu'i rjes gnang grub pa yin pas sogs mtshams sbyar spyi ltar byas la/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum gyi dam tshig bzung*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te tshar gsum/ bsod nams 'di yi sogs bsngo smon byas pas slob ma'i bya ba grub/ skabs su babs pa'i don du gnyer ba sogs dgos pa dang 'brel na/ bdag mdun gnyis kyi bar du bum pa sgrub pa dang*/ rjes gnang gi thog mtha' gang rung du bkru bya ba srung gsum gyi cho ga bya ste lag len ni spyi dang 'dra'o// mdun bskyed rjes chog mchod pa kha gsos la byin brlab/ mchod bstod (349)sngar ltar bya/ dgos 'dod kyi dngos grub blang*/ yig brgya brjod/ bzod par gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ tshom bu'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ bsngo smon dang*/

ston mchog dam pa sogs bkra shis brjod la rol mo 'khrol bar bya'o// gzungs 'di'i sgrub thabs mang na yang*// kun la 'di nyid grags che bas// gzhan la phan phyir dga' bas bris// 'dus gsal snying po ngo mtshar rmad// rnam rgyal lha dgu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// dar rgyas 'phel/// /(350)
